name: FFS_DWH_LOG
description: Used to store information about the latest run of daily extract.

columns.name: IMPORT_DATE
columns.description: Shows when Daily Extract export was ran actually.

columns.name: FROM_DATE
columns.description: Stores Daily Extract beginning of the data export period.

columns.name: TILL_DATE
columns.description: Stores Daily Extract end of the data export period.

columns.name: TIME_DIFF
columns.description: Daily Extract export time difference from GMT time zone.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: DWH_LOG_ID
columns.description: Contains unique identifier of the row. System generated.
